title: Microsoft AI opens review on Humanist AI Code of Conduct
summary: Microsoft AI has launched a six-week public consultation on their Humanist AI Code of Conduct, a technical framework that establishes operational constraints, system behavior boundaries, and oversight protocols for their frontier AI models, building on their previously announced humanist superintelligence framework.
problem_solved: Establishes structured operational boundaries and ethical constraints for AI model training and deployment at scale.
why_valuable: Provides a proactive governance framework that could set industry standards for responsible AI development and deployment practices.
